brief: Compare planned and actual spending without treating every deviation as a personal failure.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Read the spending difference"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Lee la diferencia de gasto"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Leia a diferença de gasto"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Compare planned and actual spending without treating every deviation as a personal failure.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Use the difference to investigate and improve the next plan.
instruction.misconception: Treating any spending above a forecast as proof of irresponsibility rather than checking its cause.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.

evidence.reasoning: Planned: 40; spent: 46. The difference is 6 above plan; check why before deciding what to change.
A price change can explain a difference without extra purchases.
An incomplete record cannot fully explain the spending difference.
Delayed spending can remain a future obligation.
The new required visit count is relevant to the next estimate.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

en-US.line: Use the difference to investigate and improve the next plan.

es-MX.line: Usa la diferencia para investigar y mejorar el siguiente plan.

pt-BR.line: Use a diferença para investigar e melhorar o próximo plano.

en-US.line: Planned: 40; spent: 46. The difference is 6 above plan; check why before deciding what to change.

pt-BR.line: Previsto: 40; gasto: 46. São 6 acima do plano; confira por quê antes de decidir o que mudar.

en-US.scene: Planned grocery spending: 50. Actual grocery spending: 58.
help: Subtract the planned amount from the actual amount.

feedback.not_yet: Subtract the planned amount from the actual amount.

help: Resta el monto planeado al monto real.

feedback.not_yet: Resta el monto planeado al monto real.

feedback.not_yet: Subtraia o valor previsto do valor real.

en-US.prompt: What explains the higher spending here?
en-US.scene: The same essential groceries cost more after a price increase.
help: Use the stated cause, not a personal judgment.

feedback.met: A price change can explain a difference without extra purchases.
feedback.not_yet: Use the stated cause, not a personal judgment.

es-MX.scene: La misma comida esencial costó más tras un aumento de precios.
help: Usa la causa indicada, no un juicio personal.

feedback.met: Un cambio de precio puede explicar la diferencia sin compras adicionales.
feedback.not_yet: Usa la causa indicada, no un juicio personal.

pt-BR.prompt: O que explica aqui o gasto maior?
pt-BR.scene: A mesma comida essencial custou mais após aumento de preços.
help: Use a causa informada, não um julgamento pessoal.

feedback.met: Uma mudança de preço pode explicar a diferença sem compras adicionais.
feedback.not_yet: Use a causa informada, não um julgamento pessoal.

en-US.scene: Transport was planned at 70 and actually cost 61.
help: Compare the actual cost with its planned amount.

feedback.not_yet: Compare the actual cost with its planned amount.

es-MX.scene: El transporte se planeó en 70 y costó 61.
help: Compara el costo real con su monto planeado.

feedback.not_yet: Compara el costo real con su monto planeado.

pt-BR.scene: O transporte foi previsto em 70 e custou 61.
help: Compare o custo real com seu valor previsto.

feedback.not_yet: Compare o custo real com seu valor previsto.

en-US.scene: Spending exceeds plan; some cash purchases are missing from the record.

options.label: Assume the missing purchases were free

help: Look for missing evidence before deciding on a change.

feedback.met: An incomplete record cannot fully explain the spending difference.
feedback.not_yet: Look for missing evidence before deciding on a change.

es-MX.scene: Tu total supera el plan, pero faltan compras en efectivo en el registro.

pt-BR.prompt: O que melhora primeiro a comparação?

feedback.met: Um registro incompleto não explica toda a diferença de gasto.
feedback.not_yet: Busque evidências ausentes antes de decidir uma mudança.

en-US.scene: Spending fell because a necessary repair was delayed and remains unpaid.

options.label: An assumption that the cost disappeared

help: Distinguish postponing a payment from removing its need.
